title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: Late show. Recorded by Jim Cooper from seat # BB 108 (2nd row Center) Hitachi trq-222, 2 Hitachi mikes; Transferred  >  sony d5pro2 > dbx 2231 EQ > sony rcd w500c

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1970 audience tape delivering a legendary Dark Star and mind‑bending The Other One, captured in surprisingly clear AUD quality.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as one of the Dead’s finest, with reviewers singling out an all‑time great Dark Star, a surreal third‑set stretch of The Other One, and a haunting Walking In Jordan close.  Although it’s an audience recording, listeners note the tape sounds “pretty good” and the complete set makes it worth the download.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for performance (Dark Star, The Other One) combined with generally positive remarks about the audience recording’s clarity and completeness.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the AUD as "pretty good" and note that the complete show is present; one mentions a DP version for optimal listening, but overall the tape is considered clear enough to enjoy the historic performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert builds to an unforgettable third set, highlighted by a transcendent Dark Star early on and a psychedelic stretch of The Other One that culminates in a moving Walking In Jordan close.

band_member_comments.Drums: The drum section is praised for creating an other‑worldly illusion, with the band’s sound "spilling over" after the drums and adding to the experimental vibe.
